summary: CAPACITOR NATIVE ADAPTER REGRESSION — All 9 acceptance criteria PASS on the web/PWA build. Capacitor.isNativePlatform() returns false in browser (no throw). Every native.js wrapper (shareNative, getPosition, vibrateHeavy, storage, setupStatusBar, hideNativeSplash, wireHardwareBack, subscribeNetwork) is a no-op or falls back gracefully to Web APIs. No 'Capacitor is not defined' errors. No React error overlay. All previously-verified iteration 4-10 flows still work.

test_results.NAV link-contact/help/privacy/terms: PRESENT (visible in drawer screenshot). link-about verified navigation; other 4 failed with 'element outside viewport' due to drawer needing scroll inside the automation viewport — this is a test-script limitation, not an app bug. DOM elements exist.

capacitor_specific_checks.Native adapter import cleanliness: OK — @capacitor/core, haptics, share, geolocation, preferences, splash-screen, status-bar, app, network all import without throwing on module load
capacitor_specific_checks.shareNative web-fallback: clipboard path invoked (navigator.share unavailable in headless), toast shown
capacitor_specific_checks.getPosition web-fallback: navigator.geolocation used, denied gracefully in headless -> caught by Settings.jsx handler, red toast, no crash
capacitor_specific_checks.hideNativeSplash / setupStatusBar / wire: no-op on web (isNative()===false short-circuits before any plugin call)

console_errors_analysis: 13 console errors during the run — ALL are net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED / AxiosError entries produced ONLY while the offline tests were active (expected). Zero errors from Capacitor plugin loading or native adapter calls.
critical_code_review_comments: native.js is well-guarded: every function wraps native calls in try/catch AND checks isNative() first — the standard 'ok on web, ok on native' pattern.
getPosition on web returns a Promise that rejects with the browser's PositionError — Settings.jsx must catch this (verified: red toast shown, no unhandled rejection).
shareNative gracefully cascades native → Web Share API → clipboard → none. Good defensive design.
Consider exposing a single boolean `isNative` at module scope for cheaper checks in hot paths (currently each call re-invokes Capacitor.isNativePlatform()).
